summary: Tidewater closed on August 31, 2026 the acquisition of all outstanding stock of Wilson, Sons Ultratug Participações S.A. and Atlantic Offshore Services S.A. from Wilson Sons, Ultranav and Remolcadores under an SPA dated February 22, 2026, amended August 25, 2026. Consideration was not disclosed in the excerpt; the acquired fleet adds 22 platform supply vessels. The amendment permitted closing before replacement of BNDES parent guarantees and clarified release mechanics for a Banco do Brasil loan guarantee. Watch for disclosure of purchase price, assumed debt and the timing of guarantee replacement as integration risks.
